name: Terrarium2
description: A full 3D diorama overworld: extruded terrain, depth-buffered occlusion, voxel characters and a tilt-shift miniature pass -- and battles fought on the map itself, shot over the shoulder at the nearest clear ground with a slow parallax drift and a depth-of-field pass. Purely presentational: it changes what Kanto looks like and nothing about how the game plays -- no collision, movement, encounter, battle or script is touched. Plus a SCREEN FX row (screen-space, not ray tracing): ambient occlusion in the corners the sky cannot reach, real reflections marched across the water's own swell, and light shafts toward the sun. Plus ambient life on the diorama -- butterflies and ground birds by day, dragonflies over the water, fireflies through the night, leaves on the wind. Plus water that remembers what touches it (rings off a surfer, a raindrop or a fishing float) and an ANIME or CLASSIC way of drawing it, wind drawn as strokes, clouds that throw shadows, timber bridges, a water garden, and Lavender and Vermilion rebuilt. Plus a GROUND row for what the weather leaves behind: puddles, drifting snow and footprints. Plus a sky that behaves like weather: rain you can see coming, a cloud deck over the map rather than the screen, god rays after a shower, a STORM register, and stars that go out one at a time. Plus ANIME, IMPACT, V-HAZE and HORIZON rows. Registers two render pipelines (terrarium_voxel / terrarium_tiltshift) and letter hotkeys v/g/t/c/b/p/h/k so it can sit beside upstream DRAMATIC_SHAPE without key fights. TILT and GBC FX are still held off while this mod is installed.
